title: Md Osman Gani Bhuiyan
text:
Hello, I am Md Osman Gani Bhuiyan.
I am a microbiologist with academic training in microbiology and professional experience in pharmaceutical microbiology. My current interests are in bioinformatics, computational biology, cancer genomics, transcriptomics, and disease biology.
I am particularly interested in using computational approaches to analyze high-throughput biological data and investigate molecular mechanisms underlying disease, with a growing focus on cancer genomics and transcriptomics.
Currently, I am working as a Research Assistant at CHIRAL and as an Executive in Quality Control – Microbiology at Aristopharma Ltd. I am developing my expertise in Python, R, Linux, Git/GitHub, and single-cell and bulk RNA-seq analysis, with the long-term goal of pursuing interdisciplinary research at the intersection of microbiology and computational biology.
